Current logic picks first/last match within a tier but doesn't recognize that a later 'TOTAL:' line (after rounding) supersedes an earlier 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' value."},{"id":"rc2","description":"Date parsing is ambiguous for DD/MM/YYYY vs MM/DD/YYYY. The skill lists '%d-%m-%Y' before '%m-%d-%Y' in some flows but the current pipeline accepted an MM/DD/YYYY interpretation for 034 (09/03/2018 → 2018-08-09 implies the parser swapped). Receipts in this dataset are Malaysian and almost universally DD/MM/YYYY; the parser must prefer DD/MM over MM/DD when day>12 is not disambiguating."},{"id":"rc3","description":"OCR digit confusions (1↔7, 0↔O, 8↔B) are not mitigated by cross-validating against subtotal + GST = total arithmetic when both are visible. 074 shows GST 30.45 + ExclGST 507.55 = 538.00, but extracted 702.00 is arithmetically impossible — no sanity check rejects this."},{"id":"rc4","description":"Fallback for two-line keyword/number splits (e.g., 'Grand Total' on one line, amount on next) uses only the immediate next non-empty line and stops on first exclusion. For receipts with multi-column aligned totals (078), the number may be several tokens away or on the same line but mis-tokenized; current regex may miss it."}],"skill_defects":[{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Priority tiers treat 'TOTAL' and 'NET TOTAL' / 'TOTAL AFTER ROUNDING' as equivalent within tier 4. No sub-rule prefers the LAST total-like line after a 'Rounding' or 'Adjustment' line as the final payable amount."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No arithmetic sanity check (subtotal + tax ≈ total, or cash − change ≈ total) to reject OCR-garbled totals and fall back to the next OCR variant or candidate."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Date extraction regex order and format precedence are not explicit about regional convention. Should default to DD/MM/YYYY for ambiguous slash-separated dates in receipt context, and only fall back to MM/DD/YYYY when day>12 forces it."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Multi-pass OCR voting picks by (tier, frequency) but does not break ties using arithmetic plausibility or 2-decimal-string presence; a correctly-formatted candidate (e.g., '92.80') should outrank a mis-OCR'd one."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Two-line fallback terminates on first exclusion keyword in the next line; should instead scan a small window (next 1-3 non-empty lines) skipping exclusion lines, since receipts sometimes interleave 'Rounding Adj' between keyword and amount."}],"repair_recommendations":[{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'final-total preference' rule: after collecting all tier-matching candidate lines, if any candidate line follows a 'Rounding' / 'Adjustment' / 'Rounded' line within the same section, prefer that later candidate as the final total. Equivalently, when both 'Total Incl GST' and 'Total After Rounding'/'Total RM'/'TOTAL:' appear, prefer the one closer to the end of the receipt body (before summary/GST section)."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add an arithmetic sanity check: if subtotal and GST/tax amounts are extractable from the same receipt, verify |candidate_total − (subtotal + tax)| < 0.05 (allowing for rounding). Also verify cash − change ≈ total when both present. Reject candidates that fail by >1.00 and fall back to the next-best candidate across OCR variants."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Rewrite date extraction to try formats in strict priority: (1) ISO YYYY-MM-DD; (2) DD/MM/YYYY and DD-MM-YYYY (default for receipts); (3) DD MMM YYYY; (4) MM/DD/YYYY only as last resort and only if the DD/MM interpretation is invalid (month>12). Document this as the receipt-domain default in the skill."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Strengthen multi-pass voting: for each OCR variant, record candidate (tier, raw_value_string, numeric_value). Score candidates by (a) tier priority, (b) presence of 2-decimal format in the raw string, (c) arithmetic consistency with subtotal+tax if available, (d) frequency across variants. Pick highest score."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Extend two-line fallback to scan up to 3 non-empty subsequent lines, skipping (not aborting on) exclusion lines, and also look on the SAME line to the right of the keyword using column-aware splitting (e.g., split by 2+ spaces) before falling to next line."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a per-image guard: if the chosen total string is not formattable as f'{v:.2f}' or if numeric value is implausibly large (>5× sum of visible item prices when items are OCR-visible), downgrade the candidate and try next variant/candidate."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'post-rounding keyword tier' between tiers 1 and 2: specifically match 'TOTAL AFTER ROUNDING', 'ROUNDED TOTAL', 'TOTAL ROUNDED', 'TOTAL RM' (standalone final line) and prefer these over 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' when both appear."}],"confidence":"medium"}
